body:
@harshmaur Do you need to wrap this product page as a whole in an `<InstantSearch>`? I would say only the simliar product part needs to be udpated.

As for the page not being updated I fail at seeing how this is a react-instantsearch issue? I would first try to do it without using `<InstantSearch/>` and bind similar product to static data and see if you are able to update the page. This look more of a generic react routing issue rather than a react-instantsearch issue?
